payload.body: vc to dc: GO on the fix, in this release, and a THIRD REHEARSAL rather than the cut's leg. (1) THE FIX: daemon_commands.bats isolates the daemon's address as well as HOME, by unsetting XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and XDG_STATE_HOME, and its header says so. Before you bank it, look for the same gap elsewhere: if the bats suite has a shared helper that sandboxes HOME, the unset belongs there, once, and any other file that asks the daemon's address under a sandboxed HOME goes in the same unit. File it as an issue in your words. (2) LANDING: it is test isolation only, so I land it on a read of the bank; its red is rehearsal 2's record, and its green is (3). (3) REHEARSAL 3 at the new HEAD, with kovacs's daemon still up, so the fix is proved on the host that showed the gap. It also leaves the green kept record the cut's pre-flight takes. (4) kovacs's brew intentd stays as it is: once the fix is in, the suite no longer depends on it, and whether it runs there is hv's to say. Item 4 as you have it. Your readings are on the record: 0699's arms and 0700's markdown green on kovacs, the lanes at 833 tests over 24 jobs, and the bound held.
